BSW Description
This is a unique identiﬁer for a received or a to be transmitted message. With this (and by means
of e.g. a lookup table) the PDU Router can route the message appropriately without dealing with
the particularities of the Transport Layer. This parameter can also be seen as the identiﬁer of a
connection.
